举荐名额（举荐名额（第22页）沈长青心中一凉，故作沉思之后，便是无奈道：“请容晚辈考虑考虑。”
他现在的身家是三千多万灵石，缺口尚且还有五千万灵石，若是自己不需要要用钱也就算了，可现在自己命都要保不住了又怎么可能一下子两千万灵石去赌一个不确定的未来？“你走吧。”
聂丞语气依旧平淡，从始至终都没看沈长青一眼。
沈长青弱不可察的皱了皱眉，但很快便舒展，他也不停留，直接转身就走。
这时，聂丞突然开口道：“把云守拙给你的信物还回来吧。”
沈长青取出紫金令牌，随即就见那令牌直接化作了一道紫色烟尘，消散不见。
他知道，自己师傅口中的这份交情，从这一刻起便彻底消散了。
走出庭院的时候，迎面刚好有一位穿着粉裙的少女蹦蹦跳跳的回来，那少女看了沈长青一眼，刚走进庭院便喊道：“爷爷，可是有人又来和你攀关系像进剑阁了？”
沈长青将这话听在耳中，他平静地回头看了庭院一眼，随后径直离开。
见到自己孙女，聂丞脸上瞬间绽放出和善的笑容，“莹儿，说不上是攀关系，刚才来的这小子名叫沈长青，乃是我的一位故友之徒，不过确实也是想借着曾经的交情加入剑阁。”
“爷爷，难道你把自己的举荐名额给他了？”
聂莹顿时有些不满道：“越是这种没本事的人越喜欢攀关系走捷径。”
聂丞哈哈一笑，道：“不过这小子倒也说不上没本事，能在这个年纪将雾府修炼难度足以排进前十的《太虚剑诀》修炼到圆满之境，足以说明他在剑道上拥有不错的天赋。”
听到这话，聂莹顿时有了改观，道：“倒是我眼拙了，没想到这家伙竟还真是有点本事的。”
聂丞点点头，道：“若非如此，你爷爷我也不会给他一个用两千万灵石购买剑阁外阁身份的机会了。”
聂莹听到这个数字一下子就捂着了小嘴，道：“爷爷，我记得购买外阁弟子身份不是只需要一千万灵石吗，咱们这么做会不会……”
一个能在神变境前期将《太虚剑诀》修炼至圆满的人，已经算得上是个不错的天才了。
“莹儿莫非是担心那小子记恨我们？”
聂丞道：“同为上品玄命，我知道突破至灵台境的艰难，且不说那云守拙在雾府蹉跎了这么多年，即便回到净土，他也没什么突破到灵道境的机会了，昔年的交情，呵呵，至于这小子……”
他丝毫不以为意的笑了笑，道：“一个上限就是神变境的中品奇命，即便让他知道老夫借着人情坑他他又能拿老夫怎么样？”
聂莹也笑了起来，她突然又像是想到了什么，问道：“对了，爷爷，前几天上门拜访的那位神子现在情况怎么样了？”
聂丞感慨道：“你爷爷我这辈子的上限就是灵台境，无法再往上爬，好不容易有位下品真命的天才前来结交，我又怎么可能错过？”
“所以，莹儿你就放心吧，爷爷早已把举荐的名额给他喽……”
……离开聂丞的庭院之后，沈长青又走了半个时辰才终于回到府邸。
不过，他刚想进去，身后却突然响起了一道声音。

The latest chapter of God's Reward for those who work hard: A marriage with a poor daughter at the beginning_Chapter 313 Recommended quota page 1_God's way for those who work: A marriage with a poor daughter at the beginning of the night, alone in the middle of the night_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 313 Recommendation Quota (Page 1)
Recommendation Quota (Recommendation Quota (page 22)) Shen Changqing felt a chill in his heart. After pretending to think deeply, he said helplessly: "Please allow this junior to consider it."
His current net worth is more than 30 million spiritual stones, and there is still a shortfall of 50 million spiritual stones. If he doesn't need the money, forget it, but now that his life is in danger, how can he gamble on an uncertain future with 20 million spiritual stones? "You go."
Nie Cheng's tone remained calm, and he never glanced at Shen Changqing from beginning to end.
Shen Changqing frowned imperceptibly, but soon relaxed, and without stopping, he turned around and left.
At this time, Nie Cheng suddenly said: "Give back the token that Yun Shouzhuo gave you."
Shen Changqing took out the purple gold token, and immediately saw that the token turned into a line of purple smoke and disappeared.
He knew that the friendship his master spoke of had completely dissipated from this moment on.
When walking out of the courtyard, a girl in a pink skirt jumped back in front of her. The girl glanced at Shen Changqing and shouted as soon as she entered the courtyard: "Grandpa, but someone comes to have a relationship with you again, like entering the Jiangge?"
Shen Changqing heard these words. He calmly looked back at the courtyard, and then left straight away.
Seeing his granddaughter, Nie Cheng's face instantly burst into a kind smile, "Ying'er, I can't say it's a relationship. The boy who came just now is named Shen Changqing. He is a disciple of an old friend of mine, but he really wants to join Jiange through our past friendship."
"Grandpa, did you give him your recommendation quota?"
Nie Ying suddenly felt dissatisfied and said: "The more incompetent people are, the more they like to build relationships and take shortcuts."
Nie Cheng laughed and said: "But this kid can't be said to be incompetent. To be able to perfect the "Taixu Sword Art" in Wufu at this age, which is ranked in the top ten in terms of difficulty, is enough to show that he has a good talent in swordsmanship."
After hearing this, Nie Ying suddenly changed her mind and said: "I'm blind, I didn't expect this guy to be really capable."
Nie Cheng nodded and said, "If this were not the case, I would not have given your grandfather the opportunity to use 20 million spirit stones to purchase the identity of the outer pavilion of Jiange."
When Nie Ying heard this number, she immediately covered her mouth and said, "Grandpa, I remember that it only costs 10 million spirit stones to purchase the identity of a disciple of the outer pavilion. Will we do this..."
A person who can practice the "Taixu Sword Art" to perfection in the early stages of the Divine Transformation Realm can already be regarded as a good genius.
"Is Ying'er worried that that boy will hate us?"
Nie Cheng said: "We are both high-grade Xuanming. I know how difficult it is to break through to the Lingtai realm. Not to mention that Yun Shouzhuo has wasted so many years in Wu Mansion. Even if he returns to the Pure Land, he has no chance to break through to the Lingdao realm. The friendship in the past, haha, as for this kid..."
He smiled nonchalantly and said, "The upper limit is a mid-level extraordinary life in the Divine Transformation Realm. Even if he knows that I am tricking him through favors, what can he do to me?"
Nie Ying also laughed. She suddenly thought of something again and asked, "By the way, Grandpa, how is the son of God who came to visit you a few days ago doing now?"
Nie Cheng said with emotion: "Your grandpa, my upper limit in this life is the Lingtai realm. I can't climb any higher. Finally, a low-level real-life genius came to befriend me. How could I miss it?"
"So, Yinger, don't worry, grandpa has already given him the recommended quota..."
...After leaving Nie Cheng's courtyard, Shen Changqing walked for another half an hour before finally returning to the mansion.
However, just as he was about to go in, a voice suddenly sounded behind him.
